title: The sum of 1 to n
task: Show on port 3 the sum 1 + 2 + … + n of the byte at n, taken modulo 256 as the ALU does, then stop. For n = 0 the sum is 0: make sure your loop does not run 256 times. Keep the label n and its DB line: the tests write n there.
starter:
; sum-to-n -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-2)
; Show 1 + 2 + ... + n on port 3.
; Hint: count n down in C with DCR and JNZ; test n = 0 before the loop.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0800H     ; the data, in the RAM
n:      DB 0
